ideas.title: Uncovering the Extent of Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged child care fraud in Minnesota and its impact on the state's child care system.
questions: What is the extent of the alleged child care fraud in Minnesota?
How has the federal funding freeze affected child care providers in the state?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme, and I would recommend using public records to track the financial transactions of child care providers in Minnesota.
